defmodule OrgGuard.Access.CapabilityLoader do
  @doc """
  Computes the capabilities of an actor at a given org unit.

  Precedence rules:
  - Path: U, parent(U), parent(parent(U)), ..., root (nearest first).
  - For each role R, walk path nearest-to-root, stop at the first unit that carries
    at least one RoleAssignment for this actor with that role.
  - If no unit on the path carries such an assignment, the actor does not hold R at U.
  - If the stopping unit carries ANY assignment for this actor and role with
    effect:deny, the actor does not hold R at U — even if an ancestor granted it,
    and even if the same unit also carries a grant for it.
  - Otherwise the actor holds R at U.
  - Capabilities at U are the union of the capabilities of every role held at U.
  """
